bagPolicy.summary: NRG Stadium does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: NRG Stadium event parking is managed through NRG Park. Entry gates, lot availability, pricing, and prepaid options vary by event; the venue commonly directs stadium traffic through Gate 9 at Kirby Drive and Westridge Street.

rideshare.note: Enter Yellow Lot and look for tent where rideshares can pick up.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at NRG Stadium varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible Seating, designated for guests with disabilities who use wheelchairs, other mobility devices, or otherwise require the use of the features of accessible seating (e.g., a guest with a service animal that requires the additional space offered by accessible seating), is available on all levels for all events held at Reliant Stadium and Reliant Arena.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in NRG Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: If a customer’s delivery option is will call, there will be a dedicated window for will call pickup at the Reliant Stadium Box Office. Guests are not permitted to leave tickets at will call for anyone.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Elevator lobbies are located at the main entrances on the NE, SE, SW and NW corners of Reliant Stadium.
